newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not fully established-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not fully established-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared with Monday's close, USDA said.
Trade was slow, with winter storm also affecting movement.
Demand and seller interest light. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Mondays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not fully established with a lower undertone noted.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs few 103.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 llbs no sales Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
